title: Profile
description: A learner on this device. Every stored record carries profileId, so profile switching and accounts sit on top without moving data. A preview (shadow) profile merged into the real one at the cutover keeps its record with archivedAt and archivedInto (data/session.js keepPreview) until it is purged 30 days later.

archivedAt.description: when the cutover archived this preview profile after merging it (data/session.js); archived profiles are never opened and are purged 30 days later

archivedInto.description: the id of the profile this preview was merged into
